data.narrative:
Rocket Factory Augsburg, a Series B-stage space and aerospace company that has raised $80M+, is evaluated against a comparable universe of five same-sector peers at similar or adjacent stages (Sierra Space, Cowboy Space Corporation, Varda Space Industries, Aalyria, and Skyryse) plus six public Space & Aerospace benchmarks (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL, and one additional ticker).

Two valuation methods apply. Stage-progression analysis, using the $80M raised as a proxy for current valuation and applying a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B progression, yields $152M. Peer-median anchoring across the five comparable companies produces a $1.5B implied valuation, with the peer set ranging from $1.15B to $8.0B. Public-comp P/S anchoring cannot be applied absent disclosed revenue; the sector median of 26.4x P/S across public comparables establishes a reference benchmark but remains inapplicable to this private target.

The triangulated analysis of these two applicable methods yields a valuation range of $129M (low) to $1.7B (high), with a median of $826M. The wide range reflects tension between the stage-progression method, which anchors to historical capital raised, and peer-median analysis, which reflects current market pricing for similar-stage competitors. Key uncertainty centers on RFA's revenue trajectory and path to profitability relative to peer cohorts, data not available for this valuation.
